This guide is written once and resolved at build time: the code blocks are not copied into the Markdown, they are read from the library's source files.

## Set up the library

Install the package, import the standalone component you need and add it to the `imports` of the component that uses it. Vanta UI has no module to register.

> [!NOTE]
> This section is one shared fragment (`_partials/setup.md`). Every guide that needs the same setup includes it, so the text can never drift between pages.

## Alert inputs

The inputs below are a named region of `vanta-alert.component.ts`. Change the source and regenerate, and this block changes with it. See [`VantaAlertComponent`](/docs/reference/generated/vanta-alert-component) for every input and output, and [the tone type](/docs/reference/generated/vanta-tone) for the allowed values.

:::code vanta-alert.component.ts

```ts
/** Visual intent. Required so an alert never defaults to a misleading colour. */
readonly tone = input.required<VantaTone>();
/** Short heading shown above the message. Bound as `alertTitle`. */
readonly heading = input('', { alias: 'alertTitle' });
/** Shows a close button when set. Accepts the bare attribute (`dismissible`). */
readonly dismissible = input(false, { transform: booleanAttribute });
/** Emits once, when the reader closes the alert. */
readonly dismissed = output<void>();
```

[View source](https://example.invalid/vanta/blob/v2.0.0/vanta-ui/src/vanta-alert.component.ts#L21-L28)

## A line range

Files without comments for markers can be shown by line range. These are lines 9 to 16 of the tooltip directive, documented at [`VantaTooltipDirective`](/docs/reference/generated/vanta-tooltip-directive).

```ts
export class VantaTooltipDirective {
  /** The tooltip text. Leave empty to disable the tooltip. */
  readonly vantaTooltip = input.required<string>();
  /** Delay before the bubble opens, in milliseconds. */
  readonly vantaTooltipDelay = input(300, { transform: numberAttribute });
  /** Whether the bubble is currently shown. Two-way bindable: `[(vantaTooltipOpen)]`. */
  readonly vantaTooltipOpen = model(false);
}
```

[View source](https://example.invalid/vanta/blob/v2.0.0/vanta-ui/src/vanta-tooltip.directive.ts#L9-L16)

## Source next to a live component

The wrapper below is the file that the playground renders. Operate its controls, press the preview and compare the result with the code.

:::code button-playground.ts

```ts
/**
 * A consumer-owned wrapper that applies Volt UI's `voltButton` directive. Doqs binds the inputs by their public
 * names and reports `pressed`; the directive itself is never instantiated by Doqs.
 */
@Component({
  selector: 'vanta-button-playground',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [VoltNativeButton],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `<button voltButton type="button" [variant]="variant()" [size]="size()" [disabled]="disabled()" (click)="pressed.emit(label())">{{ label() }}</button>`,
})
export class VantaButtonPlaygroundComponent {
  readonly variant = input<VoltVariant>('solid');
  readonly size = input<VoltSize>('md');
  readonly disabled = input(false);
  readonly label = input('Save changes');
  readonly pressed = output<string>();
}
```
